professionalNarrative.headline: Passionate AI Developer with Proven Deep Expertise in Problem-Solving, Enterprise Solutions, and Machine Learning
professionalNarrative.summary: I'm an AI engineer who builds systems that work in production. My foundation spans deep learning, computer vision, and full-stack development—but more importantly, I translate complex AI concepts into real business solutions. I've led teams across 25 successful projects, worked with clients from London to Dubai, and consistently delivered systems that exceed expectations. The work I do combines rigorous technical architecture with genuine understanding of what clients actually need.
professionalNarrative.perspective: What I've learned: AI is only valuable when it solves real problems and runs reliably in production. Theory matters, but execution matters more. I'm equally comfortable designing sophisticated ML pipelines, architecting enterprise systems, or jumping into a client's messy codebase to fix what's broken. That versatility comes from building things end-to-end—not delegating away the hard parts.
professionalNarrative.commitment: Certified Claude developer (Claude 101 Certification from Anthropic, AI Fluency Framework & Foundations). I practice collaborative development using AI agents for accelerated, high-quality solutions without sacrificing craftsmanship. My focus remains on core architecture, problem-solving methodology, and design patterns—supported by practical implementation and iterative refinement. Every project receives the same treatment: thoughtful engineering, thorough testing, transparent communication, and long-term support.

majorProjects.name: SmartLens: AI Threat Detection with Smart Storage
majorProjects.problemStatement: Retail outlets across vulnerable locations (high fire/looting risk) rely on passive CCTV monitoring. Threats go undetected until significant damage has occurred. Storage infrastructure can't handle 24/7 continuous recording.
majorProjects.solutionApproach: AI-powered surveillance system automating threat detection using YOLOv8 object detection. System identifies fire, weapons, suspicious behavior in real-time and triggers instant mobile notifications. Motion-based recording replaces continuous 24/7 storage, reducing overhead by 95%.

businessImpact.riskReduction: 40% reduction in incident risk through instant detection
businessImpact.storageOptimization: 95% reduction in storage costs through motion-based recording
businessImpact.responseTime: Instant alert to owners and government authorities (<1 second)
businessImpact.falsePosNegRate: YOLOv8 detection with near-zero false alarms in production

features: Real-time threat detection: fire, weapons, suspicious behavior
Mobile alerts with incident video clip
Smart storage: only records when motion/threats detected
Hardware-agnostic: works with standard CCTV feeds
majorProjects.keyMetric: Threats detected with <50ms latency, zero false alarms in live deployment

majorProjects.name: Multimodal AI Chatbot: Concurrent LLM Comparison System
majorProjects.problemStatement: Users uncertain which LLM produces best output for their needs. Each model has strengths/weaknesses. Choosing wrong model wastes time and money. No easy way to compare real-time outputs side-by-side.
majorProjects.solutionApproach: Application running 2+ LLMs concurrently (GPT-3.5, Gemini, Mistral), displaying outputs side-by-side for user comparison. Users select preferred response and system learns preferences. Solves LLM uncertainty through direct comparison rather than guessing.

database: MongoDB for conversation history and preferences

capabilities: Concurrent LLM execution (multiple models run in parallel)
OCR (Optical Character Recognition) for image input
majorProjects.userBenefit: Users get best response for their specific need by seeing live comparison, not by guessing which model to use

majorProjects.solutionApproach: Built full-stack e-commerce platform with: advanced inventory management system with rule-based SKU tracking, smart order processing logic, admin dashboard supporting bulk upload via Excel data parsing. System handles thousands of concurrent operations.
